latest.text: ProsperoStore version is broken, at least for me. Once you get through the hyperspecific payload requirements it requires an external download which it only partially sees, hence failing the initial setup. Github version didn't have this issue, but it's still barely functional. At this point PC5 is a simpler, less buggy alternative. if you want full steam and installer support, you're better off going straight to Linux.
